title: Add rollback endpoint for Optimization Config versions (authz + audit events)
author: Benji Okafor
description: Motivation: We need a safe, auditable way to revert optimization changes (batching/caching/quant profiles) without requiring a manual DB edit or redeploy. This PR adds the initial rollback API endpoint to the Optimization Config Service, including RBAC authorization, audit-log emission, and integration tests that codify the expected semantics for callers (Console + internal tooling). API: Adds POST /v1/optimization-configs/rollbacks to request a rollback for a given scope (tenant/model/region) to a target config_version_id (or "previous_promoted" shortcut). The endpoint creates a rollback operation record, performs server-side validation (scope match, version exists/visible, cooldown, and active rollout compatibility), and returns an operation_id that the rollout controller/runtime applier will observe. Authz: Enforces new permission "optimization_config.rollback" and validates caller can act on the requested scope; maps to Console "Optimization change operator" role. Audit: Emits structured audit events for rollback_requested and rollback_failed (validation/authz). Includes request_id, actor, scope, from_version, to_version, operation_id, and reason. Tests: Adds integration tests for (1) happy path rollback with audit event, (2) permission denied returns 403 and emits authz audit, (3) idempotent retry using Idempotency-Key returns same operation_id, (4) invalid target version returns 400 with actionable message and rollback_failed audit. Notes: This PR does not implement the runtime rollback execution path; it only creates the operation + emits events. Runtime/application handling is in subsequent PRs (apply transaction + canary controller).
commits: control-plane(opt-config): add rollback operation model + persistence
api: add POST /v1/optimization-configs/rollbacks handler + request validation
authz: enforce optimization_config.rollback permission + scope checks
tests: add integration coverage for rollback endpoint semantics
docs(dev): add endpoint to internal OpenAPI + examples
api_details: Request fields: tenant_id, model, region, rollback_to (config_version_id | previous_promoted), reason, dry_run (optional)
Headers: Idempotency-Key (optional but recommended), X-Request-Id (propagated to audit payload)
Response: 202 Accepted with operation_id, from_version_id, to_version_id, status=pending, effective_scope
Errors: 403 (missing permission / scope), 409 (cooldown / conflicting active operation), 400 (validation)
implementation_notes: Rollback is represented as an operation record (type=rollback) to keep semantics consistent with apply/promote operations; controller will pick it up.
Server-side validation rejects rollbacks that change scope (tenant/model/region) relative to active config pointer.
Idempotency implemented via (actor_id, scope_hash, rollback_to, idempotency_key) uniqueness with 24h TTL; retries return same operation_id.
Audit events are emitted on request acceptance and on validation/authz failure; execution success/failure events will be emitted by the controller/runtime in follow-up PRs.
testing: Manually verified via local devstack: curl POST /v1/optimization-configs/rollbacks returns 202 and creates rollback operation row
Verified audit payload appears in auditlog sink with expected fields (operation_id, from/to versions, scope)
